test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 12 April 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the correct active voice of the given sentence.**

The poems of great English poets are being translated into other languages.

options.text: They were translating the poems of great English poets into other languages.
They are translating the poems of great English poets into other languages.
They have translated the poems of great English poets into other languages.
They translated the poems of great English poets into other languages.

solution:
​The correct answer is **'****They are translating the poems of great English poets into other languages'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Passive Voice. As per the given question we have to change the sentence into Active Form. 
 
• The given sentence is an example of 'present continuous'. 
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Subject + is/am/are + V1 + ing + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject(Objective Case) + is/am/are + being+ V3 + by + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice) 
 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *He is riding a bike.*
 
• *A bike is being ridden by him. *
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'The poems of great English poets' and the object of the given sentence is 'they (hidden object)'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. 
 
• Here, 'are being translated' will be changed into 'are translating'. 
 
• The preposition 'by' will be used in the end.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *They are translating the poems of great English poets into other languages.*
